text.tspan: The Hand room- A bunch of hands stick out of the ground,
I have a bad feeling about touching any of them. I heard a
voice in my head say that I can curse a hand to be a key
The Eye room- A bunch of eyes are embedded in the wall
when they cant see me, a path is revealed to a rotten hole
in the ground, where a cursed red book is. I am afraid to
touch it, because I did not curse this book.
Big Hand Room- A giant red hand sticks of the ground.
Glowing symbols are all over the floor. I had a feeling
to put the red key in the hand. When I did, all of the
Symbols flashed red and the hand closed. Its grip is so
tight I can't even open one finger. The key is now safe in
